fields.Name: Generate Video
fields.Description: Generates a single raw AI video clip using AI video generation models (such as Black Forest Labs FLUX 3) via AIVideoRunner, with no multi-shot composition, captions, narration, or audio mixing. For composed multi-shot films with titles, lower thirds, captions, narration, and music, use Video Studio. Supports TextToVideo, ImageToVideo, Continuation, and VideoToVideo modes with reference images, keyframes, and source video loaded from MJ Storage as the caller.

fields.Name: Prompt
fields.Description: Text description of the video clip to generate.

fields.Name: Mode
fields.Description: Video generation mode: 'TextToVideo' (default), 'ImageToVideo', 'Continuation', or 'VideoToVideo'.

fields.Name: DurationSeconds
fields.Description: Requested clip duration in seconds (default: 5).

fields.Name: AspectRatio
fields.Description: Target aspect ratio in W:H format, such as '16:9' (default), '9:16', or '1:1'.

fields.Name: Quality
fields.Description: Generation quality tier: 'draft', 'standard' (default), or 'high'.

fields.Name: ReferenceImageFileIDs
fields.Description: Optional array of MJ: Files IDs for reference images (for example in ImageToVideo mode). Every file must be readable by the calling user.

fields.Name: Keyframes
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of keyframe image bindings, each shaped as { "Seconds": 0, "FileID": "..." } referencing an MJ: Files record readable by the calling user.

fields.Name: SourceVideoFileID
fields.Description: Optional MJ: Files ID of the source video clip for Continuation or VideoToVideo modes. Must be readable by the calling user.

fields.Name: WantAudio
fields.Description: Whether the video generator should synthesize native audio when supported (default: false).

fields.Name: Model
fields.Description: Optional active Video model Name or APIName to pin (for example 'FLUX 3' or 'flux-3'). When omitted, the Default Generative Video prompt's model bindings select the model with failover.

fields.Name: FileID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ: Files record where the generated video clip was stored (present when ResultCode is VIDEO_GENERATED).

fields.Name: Videos
fields.Description: Single-element MediaOutput array describing the generated video clip (with fileId when stored, or inline base64 data when storage failed, plus dimensions, durationSeconds, and provenance metadata).

fields.Name: DurationSeconds
fields.Description: Actual duration of the generated video clip in seconds.

fields.Name: ModelUsed
fields.Description: Name of the AI model that generated the video clip.

fields.Name: PromptRunID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ: AI Prompt Runs record logged for this video generation call.

fields.Name: Cost
fields.Description: Driver-reported cost for the video generation run, when reported by the provider.

fields.Name: Provenance
fields.Description: Provenance metadata object ({ Provenance: 'Generated', ModelID, ModelName, PromptRunID, JobID, Prompt, DurationSeconds, C2PA, Cost }).
